unit_definition_as_provided.definition: Axis is explicitly labeled "Days" with tick marks at 0 and 5, giving the unit of time directly.

explanation.explanation: The three schematic traces (Model #1, #2, #3) illustrating circadian signals have no y-axis label or units at all (e.g., bioluminescence/luciferase signal, a.u.), so a reader cannot tell what quantity or scale is depicted.

unit_definition_as_provided.definition: Categorical axis listing indexed circadian parameters (1–7), not a continuous quantity.
Categorical axis listing indexed circadian parameters (1–7), not a continuous quantity.
Color scale represents a Pearson-type correlation coefficient ranging from -1 to 1, which is a dimensionless statistic.
Axis labeled "Days" with tick marks 1 and 4, giving the time unit directly.
Axis labeled "Cell number" (log scale, 1–10), a dimensionless count that does not require an additional unit.
Axis labeled "Dose (µM)", explicitly giving the concentration unit.
Axis labeled "Growth inh." ranging 0–1, a dimensionless fractional inhibition value.
Categorical axis "Cell line", listing discrete cell line identities.
Categorical axis "Clock genes", listing discrete gene identities.
Color scale for gene expression heatmap runs qualitatively from "low" to "high" (relative, dimensionless); mutation heatmap color scale is binary (0/1), also dimensionless.
PCA plot axis "PC1", a dimensionless principal-component score.

PCA plot axis "PC2", a dimensionless principal-component score; 3D schematic axes "Parameter #1/#2/#3" are generic placeholders illustrating a conceptual multi-parameter space rather than reporting specific measured quantities.
3D schematic axis "#3" (Parameter #3), a generic illustrative axis for the conceptual clustering space.
